zh.name: Strawberry Data Hub 草莓及相关病原
zh.blurb: 草莓（含真菌、卵菌、细菌病原）的目录、精确基因注释、组织表达、共线块与转录因子成员。

en.name: Strawberry Data Hub
en.blurb: Catalogue, exact gene annotation, tissue expression, synteny blocks and TF members for Fragaria and its pathogens.

zh.name: WheatOmics 小麦多组学平台
zh.blurb: 小麦族的基因、表达谱、文献、注释 ID 换算、跨物种同源、变异目录与区间查询、基因/蛋白序列。

en.name: WheatOmics
en.blurb: Genes, expression, papers, annotation-ID conversion, cross-species homologs, variant catalogues and region queries, and sequences for wheat and its relatives.

zh.name: GWH 基因组仓库（NGDC）
zh.blurb: 按精确 ID 取基因组 / 组装记录，以及项目与样本元数据；不提供按物种或关键词搜索。

en.name: GWH — Genome Warehouse (NGDC)
en.blurb: Genome and assembly records plus project and sample metadata, by exact ID only.

zh.name: ICG 内参基因数据库（NGDC）
zh.blurb: 物种目录，以及每项研究自己验证过的内参基因与引物组合（不是通用推荐）。

en.name: ICG — Internal Control Genes (NGDC)
en.blurb: Species catalogue plus the reference genes and primer pairs each study itself validated.

zh.name: IC4R 水稻信息共享平台（NGDC）
zh.blurb: 仅粳稻：基因、功能注释、circRNA、lncRNA 与 ID 映射，可按染色体分页浏览 locus。

en.name: IC4R — Rice Information Resource (NGDC)
en.blurb: Japonica rice only: genes, functional annotation, circRNA, lncRNA, ID mapping, and locus browsing by chromosome.

zh.name: Gramene v69 禾本科比较基因组
zh.blurb: 全文检索、基因、差异表达与分类单元查询；实测物种是水稻的两个分类单元。

en.name: Gramene v69
en.blurb: Full-text search, genes, differential expression and taxonomy; species verified so far are two rice taxa.

zh.name: SCOD 甘蔗多组学数据库（NGDC）
zh.blurb: 仅甘蔗：基因组目录，以及按区间查基因——整条基因完全落在区间内才返回。

en.name: SCOD — Sugarcane Multi-Omics (NGDC)
en.blurb: Sugarcane only: genome catalogue and region gene queries, returning only genes fully inside the region.

zh.name: Ensembl Plants（EMBL-EBI）
zh.blurb: 拟南芥、水稻、小麦、玉米四个物种：按符号或 ID 查基因、取基因组序列、查外部 ID 映射。

en.name: Ensembl Plants (EMBL-EBI)
en.blurb: Gene lookup by symbol or ID, genomic sequence and external cross-references for four species: Arabidopsis, rice, wheat, maize.

zh.name: STRING 蛋白互作数据库（ELIXIR）
zh.blurb: 拟南芥与粳稻的蛋白互作：先把标识符解析成 STRING ID，再查互作伙伴；小麦、玉米的互作能力尚未验证。

en.name: STRING — protein interactions (ELIXIR)
en.blurb: Protein interactions for Arabidopsis and japonica rice: resolve identifiers to STRING IDs first, then query interaction partners; wheat and maize are not yet verified.

zh.name: UniProt 蛋白知识库
zh.blurb: 拟南芥、小麦、水稻、玉米的蛋白条目：按字段化查询检索，或按登录号取单条；查询必须指定返回字段，否则响应会放大十几倍。

en.name: UniProt
en.blurb: Protein entries for Arabidopsis, wheat, rice and maize: fielded search or a single entry by accession. A query must name its return fields, or responses grow by an order of magnitude.

label.en: Ask which source can answer a plain-language question; returns candidate sources, callable tool names and blind spots. It says "not covered" instead of inventing an answer.

hub_find_sources.summary: 不知道哪个数据库能回答时先用它：给一句自然语言问题（可带 species_hint/intent_hint），返回候选源与可直接调用的工具名、命中依据与盲区；没有覆盖会如实说「未覆盖」而不是「数据不存在」。它是本地目录查询，不发任何上游请求，也不代替具体工具作答。

label.en: Health sheet: current sources, each source’s scope, tool counts, budget headroom and known gaps. Local catalogue facts only — it does not promise any upstream is reachable now.

hub_status.summary: 体检用：列出本服务当前的源、每个源的语义与物种口径、工具数与意图覆盖、预算余量、已知缺口。当用户问「你能查什么／一共几个库／为什么查不到某个物种／还能加多少」时用它；也可用于排查「是没这个能力」还是「检索没召回」。纯本地目录事实，不访问上游，不承诺任何源此刻可用。
